text:
An inverter-based single-stage amplifier replaces the 5T OTA. The 5T OTA cannot reach 230 MHz on this power budget. At gm/Id of about 20 and roughly 33 µA per side, its gm tops out near 0.67 mS. About 1.1–1.8 mS is needed for roughly 0.6 pF of effective load, and the mirror pole slows it further.

A CMOS inverter at a trip point of 0.9 V uses its whole current twice, giving gm_n + gm_p. The PMOS sits in weak inversion, so gm/Id is high. There is also no mirror pole. The width ratio trims the trip point to 0.9 V, which keeps the offset small. The cap network (C1/C2/Cf) is kept matched to the resistor ratios, with the device's Miller cgd counted as part of Cf.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "5T OTA gm-limited (max ~0.67 mS at budget) and slowed by mirror pole; 230 MHz needs >1.1 mS. Switch to inverter-based amp (gm_n+gm_p from same current, no mirror pole), trip point trimmed to 0.9 V by Wp, matched C network with Miller cgd absorbed into Cf."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "L_n":      (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),      # nfet length [um]
    "L_p":      (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),      # pfet length [um]
    "i_inv":    (56e-6, 35e-6, 63e-6),  # inverter current at 0.9 V trip point (sets W)
    "kp":       (1.0, 0.75, 1.35),      # pfet width trim (moves trip point)
    "R1":       (5.0e5, 1.0e5, 2.0e6),
    "cf_ratio": (3.0, 1.5, 8.0),        # Cf_total / gate-node cap
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd, vcm = 1.8, 0.9
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.5e-12)

    imax = 0.95 * 140e-6 / vdd - iref
    itar = min(p["i_inv"], imax)
    Ln, Lp = p["L_n"], p["L_p"]

    def find_w(dev, L, I, vg, vd):
        W0 = 10.0
        W = W0 * I / lut.op(dev, W0, L, vg, vd)["Id"]
        W = W * I / lut.op(dev, W, L, vg, vd)["Id"]
        return W

    Wn = max(0.42, find_w("n", Ln, itar, 0.9, 0.9))
    Wp = max(0.42, p["kp"] * find_w("p", Lp, itar, 0.9, 0.9))

    # trip point: Id_n(v) = Id_p(vdd - v) with vout ~ 0.9
    lo, hi = 0.5, 1.3
    for _ in range(50):
        m = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        dn = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, m, 0.9)["Id"]
        dp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vdd - m, 0.9)["Id"]
        if dn < dp:
            lo = m
        else:
            hi = m
    vm = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    opn = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vm, 0.9)
    opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vdd - vm, 0.9)
    iinv = opn["Id"]
    gm = opn["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    gds = opn["gds"] + opp["gds"]

    cgd_est = 0.25e-15 * (Wn + Wp)          # overlap (Miller, acts as feedback cap)
    cdd_est = 0.5e-15 * (Wn + Wp)           # drain junction + overlap at out
    cgg = opn["cgg"] + opp["cgg"]
    cnode = max(cgg - cgd_est, 0.5 * cgg) + 5e-15

    # resistor network, calibrated for finite gain
    R1 = p["R1"]
    g1t, g2t = 0.15709, 0.01797
    Rf, R2 = g1t * R1, g1t * R1 / g2t
    corr, beta, A = 1.0, 0.85, 10.0
    for _ in range(10):
        Gl = 1.0 / (Rf + 1.0 / (1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2))
        A = gm / (gds + Gl)
        beta = (1 / Rf) / (1 / Rf + 1 / R1 + 1 / R2)
        corr = A * beta / (1 + A * beta)
        Rf = g1t * R1 / corr
        R2 = Rf * corr / g2t
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * corr
    a2 = -(Rf / R2) * corr

    # matched capacitive network (Cf total includes Miller cgd)
    Cf_tot = p["cf_ratio"] * cnode
    Cf = max(Cf_tot - cgd_est, 1e-15)
    tau = Rf * Cf_tot
    C1, C2 = tau / R1, tau / R2
    csum = C1 + C2 + cnode
    beta_hf = Cf_tot / (Cf_tot + csum)
    cout = cl + Cf_tot * csum / (Cf_tot + csum) + cdd_est
    bw = gm * beta_hf / (2 * PI * cout)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vinn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vinn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RI1", "vin1", "vinn", R1)
    n.R("RI2", "vin2", "vinn", R2)
    n.R("RF", "vinn", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CI1", "vin1", "vinn", C1)
    n.C("CI2", "vin2", "vinn", C2)
    n.C("CF", "vinn", "vout", Cf)
    n.C("CDUM", "vcm", "vss", 1e-15)

    off = (vm - vcm) * A / (1 + A * beta)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw,
               "vout_offset": off,
               "power": vdd * (iref + iinv)}
```
